capabilities.title: Set a governing question
capabilities.purpose: Give inquiry an explicit human purpose.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Current governing questions are mutable snapshots; their formulation and revisions are not recorded as a complete historical act.

capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Set a question as a compass; it does not predetermine the conclusion.

capabilities.title: Read source material

prerequisites.reason: An eligible source extraction with readable text is required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Registration, extraction and aggregate progress do not prove a reading session or comprehension.

expected_outputs: Human encounter with source material; not durably measured in v1
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Read the source directly before asking for an explanation.

capabilities.title: Mark anchored evidence
capabilities.purpose: Preserve attention to an exact source passage.

prerequisites.reason: An eligible source extraction with readable text is required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Reader marks are current mutable snapshots with unknown authorship; they do not prove complete historical marking behavior.

capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Save the exact passage that caught your attention and retain its source anchor.

capabilities.title: Record or inspect an observation
capabilities.purpose: Keep source-derived units and human observation candidates distinct.

prerequisites.reason: Retain eligible evidence with a stable source anchor first.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Compiled Observations do not prove human observation; promoting a Reader mark changes a candidate status rather than creating a canonical Observation.

expected_outputs: Inspectable canonical Observation or anchored Reader observation candidate
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Inspect the preserved source unit or designate an anchored mark as a candidate without rewriting the evidence.

capabilities.title: Preserve an inquiry question
capabilities.purpose: Retain a separately identified question without forcing a conclusion.

prerequisites.reason: Retain eligible evidence with a stable source anchor first.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Without an extant supported inquiry note, historical question preservation is unknown; mutable highlight question fields are not separate question identities.

expected_outputs: Individually identified inquiry note; authorship may remain unknown
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Keep a question attached to its evidence. A saved note proves retention, not resolution or authorship.

capabilities.title: Organize evidence
capabilities.purpose: Compare multiple distinct evidence anchors before synthesis.

prerequisites.reason: At least two distinct eligible evidence identities are required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Bucket labels and rankings are mutable state; Board and Scope selections do not establish durable organization history.

expected_outputs: Current evidence organization; no durable bucket identity introduced
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Bring distinct evidence together and decide what belongs; grouping does not admit material into Scope.

capabilities.title: Explore a Perspective
capabilities.purpose: Examine supported inquiry from an explicit interpretive frame.

prerequisites.reason: Supply a current governing question or a supported preserved inquiry question.
Retain eligible evidence with a stable source anchor first.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Only a validated, eligible retained single-Perspective execution proves the narrow execution-and-retention result; absent receipts do not establish no past activity.

expected_outputs: Exact framed examination; explicit Keep produces an append-only execution receipt without implying agreement
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Choose a frame and explicitly admit the material to Scope. Current readiness is not provider authorization.

capabilities.title: Form a supported interpretation
capabilities.purpose: Develop an attributable interpretation anchored in canonical evidence.

prerequisites.reason: An eligible canonical Observation is required.
A named saved or explicitly supplied current Perspective frame is required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: A proposal is not a canonical Interpretation; unknown origin cannot establish attributable formation. Extant records are not complete formation history.

expected_outputs: Canonical Interpretation with recorded human or accepted-model origin
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Separate what the evidence says from your interpretation; retain acceptance and model origin where recorded.

capabilities.title: Challenge an interpretation
capabilities.purpose: Check a proposal or interpretation against its supporting evidence and alternatives.

prerequisites.reason: An eligible canonical Interpretation or staged interpretation proposal is required.
An eligible canonical Observation is required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: A proposal-scoped Critic report proves evaluation output, not human review or deliberate contradiction-seeking; rejection alone is not a challenge event.

expected_outputs: Bounded Critic evaluation or human examination; no review event invented
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Test the claim against its evidence and alternatives. Critic findings remain separate from Steward judgment.

capabilities.title: Review the Blueprint
capabilities.purpose: Examine how a retained Blueprint organizes claims and evidence.

prerequisites.reason: An eligible saved Blueprint is required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Blueprint creation and supersession do not prove that a user reviewed a Blueprint or that evidence caused a revision.

expected_outputs: Human review; any revision still follows the existing exact approval contract
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Check the retained Blueprint against its evidence; a recommendation cannot ratify or revise it.

capabilities.title: Review study lineage
capabilities.purpose: Inspect the retained identity and provenance of the study.

prerequisites.reason: At least one eligible Lineage item is required.

refusal_or_unknown_conditions.reason: Lineage opening, filtering, context inspection and export have no durable review event.

expected_outputs: Read-only inspection of extant study records
capabilities.user_facing_explanation: Trace what is actually retained and notice the stated gaps without inventing missing history.
